scripts.name: Setup worktree
scripts.command: root="${T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT:-$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)")}"; if [ "$(cd "$root" && pwd -P)" != "$(pwd -P)" ] && [ ! -e .env ] && [ -f "$root/.env" ]; then cp "$root/.env" .env && chmod 600 .env && echo "Copied the project .env into this worktree (mode 0600)."; else echo "Keeping this worktree's .env as is."; fi
